entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A small rogue plane drifting through the multiverse, incredibly rich in sentient mana where magic is commonplace.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: A planeswalker and protector of Shandalar who trained two adepts.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A powerful necromancer who tried to conquer Shandalar and survived beheading by transferring his soul.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: A planeswalker who attacked Shandalar and was killed by Sahrmal's astral dragon.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker who attacked Shandalar and was routed.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who brought Lim-Dûl to Shandalar to wage war; the city of Lesh is named for him.

entities.name: Azar
entities.description: Sahrmal's rash apprentice who cast a spell trapping his soul and Lim-Dûl's in his own body.

entities.name: The Guardian
entities.description: Sahrmal's other apprentice, who became Protector of Shandalar and established the five guilds of magic.

entities.name: Lichlord Skavius Slan
entities.description: The soulless body of Azar, risen on its own to rule the Black Guild.

entities.name: Arzakon
entities.description: A powerful planeswalker who manipulated the Guildlords to strike down the Guardian.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who came to Shandalar for the Chain Veil and was cursed by its power.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker sent by the demon Kothophed to retrieve the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon who sent Liliana Vess to retrieve the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Talrand
entities.description: A warlord who rules the Kapsho Seas and allied the merfolk with the drakes.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who used Shandalar's wandering to cast the World Spell on Dominaria.

entities.name: Xathrid
entities.description: A major demon worshipped by the Cult of Xathrid.

entities.name: The Onakke
entities.description: A once-brilliant race of ogres, slaughtered in ages past, whose dormant masters were empowered during the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Guildlords of Shandalar
entities.description: The leaders of the five guilds of magic, who struck down the Guardian.

entities.name: Cult of Xathrid
entities.description: A cult that has enticed humans, gorgons and demons on Shandalar.

entities.name: Ardestan
entities.description: The last city standing against Lim-Dûl and once the capital of Shandalar.

entities.name: Kapsho Seas
entities.description: Seas ruled by Talrand and home to the Amphin.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact hidden within the Onakke catacombs whose foul magic empowered the Onakke.

entities.name: Great Barrier
entities.description: A barrier around Shandalar created by Azar's spell, dependent on confinement of Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's War
entities.description: The war in which Lim-Dûl's undead army destroyed city after city on Shandalar.

entities.name: Wizards' War
entities.description: The war in which the five wizard schools defeated Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian attack that targeted Shandalar.

events.summary: During the time of the Shard of the Twelve Worlds, Faralyn, Tevesh Szat, Leshrac and Lim-Dûl invade Shandalar.
events.quote: They immediately began to wage war upon the plane, ready to claim it for their own.

events.summary: Sahrmal kills Faralyn with a summoned astral dragon and routs the others; Lim-Dûl injures Sahrmal, and Sahrmal's followers behead Lim-Dûl.
events.quote: managed to kill Faralyn with a summoned astral dragon

events.summary: Freyalise uses Shandalar's wandering to cast the World Spell on Dominaria, ending the Ice Age and shattering the Shard.
events.quote: the unique wandering of Shandalar was used by Freyalise to cast the World Spell ending that plane's Ice Age and shattering the Shard.

events.summary: Twelve years later Lim-Dûl returns with an undead army and destroys city after city until only Ardestan remains.
events.quote: City after city on the plane was destroyed until, after years of war, only one city remained, Ardestan .

events.summary: Azar leaves sanctuary to defend Ardestan against Sahrmal's counsel, and Sahrmal and his other apprentice follow.
events.quote: Azar, unable to witness the suffering and inevitable fall of Ardestan without doing something about it, left their hidden sanctuary and went to the defense of the city.

events.summary: Azar's spell and Lim-Dûl's counter trap both spirits in Azar's body; Sahrmal secretly buries it as the Great Barrier forms.
events.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar's body.

events.summary: Sahrmal invests his remaining power in his other apprentice, who becomes the Guardian, and vanishes again.
events.quote: Sahrmal's pupil became known as The Guardian and took up the role of Protector of Shandalar.

events.summary: The Guardian establishes five guilds of magic, each teaching one color of mana.
events.quote: The Guardian established five guilds of magic

events.summary: In the Wizards' War the five wizard schools resist Lim-Dûl, who is defeated; the Guardian imprisons his soul in an artifact.
events.quote: The Guardian removed Lim-Dûl's soul from Azar's body and imprisoned it within a magical artifact

events.summary: Azar's empty body rises and becomes Lichlord Skavius Slan, ruling the Black Guild.
events.quote: it rose on its own and took the name Lichlord Skavius Slan .

events.summary: Manipulated by Arzakon, the Guildlords rise up and strike down the Guardian.
events.quote: rose and struck down the Guardian.

events.summary: Arzakon tricks the Guildlords into seeking the Spell of Dominion, really meant to destroy the artifact that sustains the Great Barrier.
The Great Barrier fails, the Guilds fall, and new nations rise; Ob Nixilis comes for the Chain Veil and is cursed.
events.quote: At some point, Ob Nixilis came for the Chain Veil and was cursed by its power.

events.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion, the Chain Veil's magic empowers the Onakke, and wild mana shreds compleated Phyrexians' augmentations.
events.quote: Compleated Phyrexians on the plane found their metallic augmentations shredded by the pervasive wild magic of the plane's mana.

events.summary: Drakes and merfolk under the Kapsho Sea die driving the Phyrexians to the edges of the world.
events.quote: They drove the Phyrexians to the edges of the world, and they died there.

relations.quote: Since his apparent death, he had been training two adepts.

relations.note: invested his remaining power in him
relations.quote: Sahrmal invested all of his remaining power into his other apprentice.
managed to kill Faralyn with a summoned astral dragon
Lim-Dûl , a powerful necromancer, was brought along by Leshrac.

relations.note: commands the Black Guild, one of the Guilds
relations.quote: Then it took command of the Black Guild and ruled for ages

relations.note: warlord who allied with the drakes
relations.quote: They recovered after the warlord Talrand formed an alliance with the telepathic drakes .
The Veil itself is an artifact hidden within the catacombs of the Onakke
